digest.component_or_area: CI/CD testing infrastructure; pytest test suite optimization
propositions: The three recent selected CI runs averaged 24m58s wall time with no individual pytest phase exceeding 30s; the CI top-25 log truncation is a measurement limitation and does not claim completeness below rank 25.

Local exhaustive macOS census on origin/main identified 501 unique >=1.0s phases (403 default, 73 integration), with maxima 15.62s default and 21.96s integration; no single phase approached the 30-40m total completion long pole.

Gerrit 1817 (53efe2426e) is merged and removes 19 proven OS/Python-invariant repository-policy nodes from macOS/Ubuntu 3.11/3.12 while retaining them in Ubuntu 3.13, yielding ~8s macOS and 24.84 aggregate runner-second savings with no new job/setup overhead; no organic post-merge descendant has yet measured the delta.

Every inventoried >=1.0s phase has a disposition (KEEP, KEEP-EQUIVALENCE-ONLY, KEEP-RESEARCH, KEEP-SHORTEN-TEST-WINDOWS) with documented failure mode rationale and OSS precedent; no fidelity-preserving consensus primitive exists to further reduce macOS assurance.

The ranked next actions prioritize test-only observability windows (songful-groovelike-horsemouse), equivalence research for scanner/show-burst (lead-unpleasing-kitten, reasonable-kingsize-polliwog, rival-ammoniacal-crustacean), and monitoring of real platform/Git/process/packaging/signing boundaries; no new shard or runner increase is approved.
